name.zh: 美国NSF产学中心：成员参与的竞争前研究

mechanism.zh: 高校组织持续研究，产业成员参与议题选择，中心围绕明确的技术方向开展竞争前合作。
mechanism.en: Universities sustain research programmes with industrial members involved in selecting precompetitive technical topics.

conditions.zh: 企业存在可共同研究的问题，并愿意持续参与；研究议题和成员权益能够在中心层面协调。
conditions.en: Firms have shared research problems, sustained participation and workable arrangements for topics and member interests.

factors.zh: 学术团队与成员需求在中心内对接，名录分别保留高校和成员名单，不将所有成员一概视为企业。
factors.en: Academic teams connect with member demand; university and member lists are retained without treating every member as a company.

government.zh: 支持共性研究的组织成本，并以企业持续参与和议题实际进展观察运行效果。
government.en: Support coordination costs for shared research and track sustained industry participation and progress on agreed topics.

boundary.zh: 代表NSF计划中的中心安排，不代表美国所有科产合作，也不证明已产生商业收益。
boundary.en: These centres represent one NSF arrangement, not all US collaboration or demonstrated commercial returns.

name.zh: 巴西EMBRAPII：按技术专长组织应用研发

mechanism.zh: 认证单元以明确的技术专长对接企业问题，由企业与研究单元协商研发项目。
mechanism.en: Accredited units match defined technical competencies with company problems and negotiate applied R&D projects.

conditions.zh: 研究单元具备工程交付能力，企业能够提出需求，并就投入、工作范围和成果安排达成协议。
conditions.en: Units require delivery capability and firms must agree needs, inputs, work scope and result arrangements.

factors.zh: 分布式技术能力与产业需求匹配，认证网络降低企业寻找合作方的成本。
factors.en: A distributed competence network connects industrial demand with technical service capacity.

government.zh: 将支持对象落实到技术能力与可交付服务，跟踪项目履约和企业后续采用。
government.en: Fund identifiable technical capability and services, following delivery and subsequent industrial use.

boundary.zh: 单元数量表示网络覆盖，不能作为产业化绩效；同一网络内案例也不彼此独立。
boundary.en: Unit counts measure coverage, not commercialisation performance; units share a programme framework.

name.zh: 日本JST：围绕社会目标建设共创平台

mechanism.zh: 代表机构与合作主体围绕共同社会愿景组织研究开发，并同步建设持续合作平台。
mechanism.en: A lead institution and collaborators organise R&D around a shared societal vision while building a cooperation platform.

conditions.zh: 代表机构有协调能力，合作方能把共同愿景分解为研究任务及应用安排。
conditions.en: A capable lead and partners translate their shared vision into research tasks and application arrangements.

factors.zh: 将科研能力与区域资源循环、健康、能源或其他应用需求结合。
factors.en: Research capability is connected with regional circularity, health, energy and other application needs.

government.zh: 明确公共目标、合作职责和阶段性验证，避免以平台挂牌代替实际协作。
government.en: Specify public objectives, partner responsibilities and staged validation instead of relying on platform designation.

boundary.zh: 名录可证实平台与代表机构，不能单独证明目标实现；阶段升级不等于机构成立。
boundary.en: The directory verifies platforms and leads, not achieved outcomes; programme advancement is not founding.
